1.body:
Hello,

I saw your opening for a UI UX Designer at Finlaxmi and wanted to reach out because your focus on building a jargon-free retirement planner for everyday Indians stood out to me immediately.

During my time at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and fed those findings directly back into user flows and interface usability. I also built reusable design systems and 100+ digital creatives at Ascent Business Solutions to streamline turnaround times.

My Bounceless case study demonstrates my ability to turn user research into a clean, structured verification flow: https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/

Could I share a quick note on how I approach user testing and design handoffs?

Ananya Saini
+91-8605846929
https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/
